title: Harvest Moon - Friends of Mineral Town

match.zip: Harvest Moon - Friends of Mineral Town.zip

sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 4853 (addresses via C2 ra_notes.py)
notes: Genre: Simulation. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text:
Stamina and fatigue limit work each day: eat or rest to recover.
Shipping bin pays at 5 PM.
widgets.label: Day

widgets.text: A use tool / talk, B run (hold) / cancel, R/L switch tool/item, Start menu
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text:
Bachelorettes: Mary, Popuri, Elli, Ann, Karen (and the Harvest Goddess).
Give gifts daily to raise affection (hearts).
Blue Feather + big house + high hearts to propose.
widgets.label: Marriage

widgets.text:
Crops must be watered daily except on rainy days.
Typhoons and blizzards keep you inside.
Festivals close shops.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Farm, Town square, Rose Square, Mother's Hill, the beach, the hot spring and the mines (spring mine and lake mine).
widgets.label: Places

widgets.text: 30 days each: Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter.
widgets.label: Seasons

widgets.text:
Hoe, axe, hammer, watering can, sickle, fishing rod, milker, brush, shears.
Upgrade tools at Saibara's with ores mined in the mines.
widgets.label: Tools

widgets.text:
Power Berries raise max stamina; Harvest Sprites help with farm work.
Shipping every item type fills the shipping list.
widgets.label: Collect

widgets.text: Grow the farm, upgrade the house, marry and raise a family; dig to the bottom of the mines.
widgets.label: Goal
